--- your triage ---
onset: 2026-03-17T09:14:00.000Z
The deploy occurred at 09:10:00 (changes.jsonl:1). Worker memory (rss_mb) was stable around 407-432 MB through 09:14:00, then began climbing at 09:15:00 from 464 MB (metrics/worker.csv:17), reaching 1929 MB by 09:58:00 (metrics/worker.csv:60). The first restart occurred at 09:20:00 with restarts_total incrementing from 0 to 1 (metrics/worker.csv:22). HTTP error_rate jumped from baseline ~0.002 to 0.0145 at 09:14:00 (metrics/http.csv:16), correlating with memory growth onset. Worker jobs_per_min dropped from 56-67 range to 27-48 range starting 09:23:00 (metrics/worker.csv:25), indicating degraded throughput. HTTP p95 latency climbed from ~180ms to 342ms. RPS remained stable (322-367), showing this was not load-driven. The WorkerRestartLoop alert fired at 09:32:00 (alerts.jsonl:1) and JobBacklogGrowing at 09:38:00 (alerts.jsonl:2). The pattern indicates a memory leak introduced by the 'memoise partner lookups' change, with symptoms appearing 4 minutes post-deploy.
